optional_order_fields.order_generated_time_raw: Original displayed tracker timestamp; never silently promoted to signal/submission time
optional_order_fields.generated_time_utc: Optional timezone-verified conversion; still not submission time
optional_order_fields.broker_fill_time_raw: Original filled-column timestamp, blank for unfilled orders
optional_order_fields.status_time_raw: Status transition time including rejection/cancellation, not inherently a fill
optional_order_fields.coverage_verified: Explicit true declaration needed to classify a supplied no-fill expected event as missed
optional_order_fields.source: Original export/source and row identity; preserve raw files and execution-leg details

event_unit: Reviewed strategy signal ID shared across all account copies/retries; distinct IDs need not be statistically independent
time_rule: UTC fields must include Z or offset; raw tracker and chart timestamps remain separate
bar_rule: Exact minute close at or before anchor+offset; no nearest-future bar, interpolation or forward-fill
quote_rule: One reviewed same-contract quote, not after anchor and at most 1 second old; explicitly verified freshness; bid>0 and ask>bid

proposal_schema.role: Chart observation snapshots only; not accepted automatically as canonical signal/submission/fill quotes
